WITH FemaleClients AS (
  SELECT client_id, birth_date, district_id
  FROM client
  WHERE gender = 'F'
),
OldestClient AS (
  SELECT MIN(birth_date) AS oldest_birth_date
  FROM FemaleClients
),
LowestSalaryDistrict AS (
  SELECT district_id, MIN(A11) AS lowest_salary
  FROM district
  GROUP BY district_id
),
HighestSalaryDistrict AS (
  SELECT MAX(A11) AS highest_salary
  FROM district
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT account_id 
   FROM disp 
   WHERE client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM FemaleClients WHERE birth_date = (SELECT oldest_birth_date FROM OldestClient))) AS account_number,
  (SELECT highest_salary FROM HighestSalaryDistrict) - (SELECT lowest_salary FROM LowestSalaryDistrict) AS salary_gap;	----- bird -----	financial

  SELECT
    Segment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2012%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Consumption2012,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2013%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Consumption2013
  FROM
    yearmonth
  JOIN
    customers ON yearmonth.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID
  WHERE
    Currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY
    Segment
)
SELECT
  Segment,
  (Consumption2013 - Consumption2012) AS IncreaseOrDecrease,
  ((Consumption2013 - Consumption2012) / Consumption2013) * 100 AS PercentageIncrease
FROM
  ConsumptionData
